question: In what kind of ritual place may the fire-offering be performed?
premises: The rite may be performed in a fire pit.
The rite may be performed on an altar ground.
The place must be endowed with all proper marks.
inference: The fire-offering may be performed in a fire pit or on an altar ground, provided it has all the required marks.
plain_english: In a fire pit or on an altar ground, endowed with all the proper marks.
